item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must prevent its construction—not hope that systems smarter than humanity will remain under our control.

2. We are on a path toward building machines that surpass humanity in every domain that matters. If superintelligent AI is built in the next 20 years, the result will be catastrophe and at least a billion deaths. We must stop it.

3. Superintelligence is not just another powerful technology. If it is built within 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are working to secure the only responsible outcome: do not build it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We need to say this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We do not expect humanity to retain control of systems that surpass us across the domains that determine power. Once such systems can outthink their creators, evade safeguards, and shape the physical world, a mistake or conflict will not remain contained. The stakes are not a bad product launch, a market crash, or even a conventional war. They are mass death on an unprecedented scale. That is why we are working to build public and political support for preventing the construction of superintelligence before it is too late.
